alert: Security: refused sign-ins above 20 in 5 minutes
description: More than 20 password or identity-provider sign-ins were refused across the deployment in five minutes, read from the audit chain, including for addresses that belong to no account, which no tenant records. Those events are in the chain with no tenant, which is exported best effort.

annotations.description: More than 20 password or identity-provider sign-ins were refused across the deployment in five minutes, read from the audit chain, including for addresses that belong to no account, which no tenant records. Those events are in the chain with no tenant, which is exported best effort.

filter.expression: audit.resource = 'AshEnterprise.Security.AuthenticationEvent' AND audit.authentication.outcome = 'refused' AND audit.authentication.door IN ('password', 'oidc')
